subject: Constraining all factor loadings to sum to 1.

messages.author: 189d19347ab44a74
messages.subject: Constraining all factor loadings to sum to 1.
parts:
Hi, 

I am trying to fit the model described in Davision, Kim, and Close (2009). Factor Analytic Modeling of Within Person Variation in Score Profiles. Multivariate Behavioral Research, 44(5), 668 - 687. Basically, I want to replicate their MPlus syntax on p 687 in lavaan using the HolzingerSwineford1939 data set. Here's what I've done.

data <- HolzingerSwineford1939[,7:ncol(HolzingerSwineford1939)]
data <- scale(data)

model <- "
f1 =~ 1*x1 + 1*x2 + 1*x3 + 1*x4 + 1*x5 + 1*x6 + 1*x7 + 1*x8 + 1*x9
f2 =~ lam1*x1 + lam2*x2 + lam3*x3 + lam4*x4 + lam5*x5 + lam6*x6 + lam7*x7 + lam8*x8 + lam9*x9 
f1 ~~ f2
f2 ~~ 1*f2
0 == lam1 + lam2 + lam3 + lam4 + lam5 + lam6 + lam7 + lam8 + lam9
"

When I go to fit it, I get the following message:

> fit <- sem(model, data = data)
Error in lav_partable_constraints_ceq(lavpartable, con = NULL, debug = debug) : 
  lavaan ERROR: non-free parameter(s) in inequality constraint: lam1
In addition: Warning message:
In lavData(data = data, group = group, group.label = group.label,  :
  lavaan WARNING: data argument has been coerced to a data.frame


Am I doing something wrong?  

I've pasted their Mplus syntax below.

Chris



+++++

MPLUS Model Code for the Within Person Factor Model With a Random Intercept

The observed variables in the model are LOT1–LOT7. F1 is the random intercept and f2 is the Optimism factor. The loadings along the second latent variable are lam1–lam7.

MODEL:

Comment: This command fixes the loading on f1 to 1.00 for all variables. 

f1 by LOT1-LOT7@1;

Comment: This command defines lam1–lam7 as the loadings of LOT1–LOT7 on f2.

f2 by LOT1* (lam1) 

LOT2-LOT7(lam2-lam7);

Comment: This command fixes the variance of f2 to 1.0.

 f2@1;

Comment: This command asks for the covariance of f1 and f2 to be estimated. 

f1 with f2;

Comment: This command constrains the sum of loadings along f2 to zero.

MODEL CONSTRAINT:

0=lam1+lam2+lam3+lam4+lam5+lam6+lam7;

messages.subject: Re: Constraining all factor loadings to sum to 1.
parts:
Unlike Mplus, lavaan does not handle constraints with a 0 on the left side (I think). The easiest fix it a bit of algebra:

lam1 = -1*lam2 - lam3 - lam4 - lam5 - lam6 - lam7 - lam8 - lam9

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Constraining all factor loadings to sum to 1.
parts:
On 12/01/2014 05:21 PM, Alex Schoemann wrote:
> Unlike Mplus, lavaan does not handle constraints with a 0 on the left
> side (I think).

Hm. lavaan can handle this perfectly well. But lavaan (0.5-17) does not
like to have fixed parameters in the "==" formula. The 'lam1' parameter
is fixed (to 1) by default.

In the Mplus syntax, this parameter is explicitly made free:

f2 by LOT1* (lam1)

So you can the same in lavaan, by writing

f2 =~ NA*x1 + lam1*x1 + lam2*x2 + lam3*x3 + lam4*x4 + lam5*x5 + lam6*x6

or use std.lv = TRUE

Yves.
